resources.string: To float the mini companion pill over Pokémon GO, please grant "Display over other apps" permission.

Next, Android will ask if PoGo Companion can see your screen. Tap “Start now”.

That lets the ⚡ SCAN button read the Pokémon name and CP. The screen is only read when you tap SCAN, it happens on this phone, and nothing is ever saved or sent anywhere.

Android asks once each time you start the pill. Closing the pill stops it.
